translated_title: The Korean Firm Kia Will Invest $649 Million in Mexico to Start Production of Electric Vehicles in the Country
original_title: La firma coreana Kia invertirá 649 mdd en México para iniciar en el país la producción de vehículos eléctricos
author: Alma E. Muñoz and Néstor Jiménez
meta_description: Production starts August 4 at the Pesquería, Nuevo León plant, creating 500 jobs this year and 1,500 more by 2030, with nearly 27 percent national content.
